blind.description: A traditional metal chalice or goblet with an ornate cup section, a slender turned stem featuring a central knop, and a circular stepped base. The surface is smooth and continuous with a polished golden or brass metallic finish, sitting flat on the floor on its own base without defects or extra plinths.
blind.from_above: A circular ring showing the opening and hollow interior of the cup bowl, with a small shadow cast upwards.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 8 to 10 inches tall (around 1/8 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 to 4 inches wide at the rim.

notes: golden/brass finish rather than pale silver
gemini note: golden/brass finish rather than pale silver
